description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Lich's Mastery and causing each opponent to create a token copy of Lich's Mastery.
Lich's Mastery leaves the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, cast Tempest of Light by paying {2}{W}, destroying all enchantments.
Each opponent's Lich's Mastery triggers, causing them to lose the game.
